profile.headline: Software Engineer (iOS Developer)
profile.summary: Hello, my name is Tommy. I have been making iOS applications for the last 4 years. I love combining my interest for tech with my other interests of sports, fashion, and finance. If you have any engaging iOS projects feel free to ping me.

positions.title: Software Engineer (iOS Engineer)
positions.description: Helped to develop iOS hospitality application. Converted UIKit frameworks into SwiftUI following The Composable Architecture (TCA).
positions.insights: Skills: The Composable Architecture · SwiftUI · Model-view-viewmodel (MVVM)

positions.title: Software Engineer (iOS Developer)
positions.description: Developed iOS E-Commerce platform to be used by multiple retail grocery companies (Family Dollar, SaveMart, Lucky, 99Cent, etc). Improved the accessibility of applications used by thousands of users. Converted UIKit frameworks into SwiftUI. Helped to Develop E-Commerce multiplatform framework that leveraged Kotlin Multiplatform, SwiftUI and Jetpack Compose.
positions.insights: Skills: Git · SwiftUI · Software Development · Communication · UIKit · Multithreading · clean architecture · Mobile Applications · Computer Science · Kotlin · Model-view-viewmodel (MVVM)

positions.title: Software Engineer (iOS Developer)
positions.description: Developed an iOS real time transit app prioritizing accessibility by integrating user's location, Apple MapKit, Google Transit and Restful API calls.

positions.title: Software Engineer (iOS Developer)
positions.description: Developed iOS application to create custom clothing and purchase. Application uses Firebase Messenger, Firebase Cloud Functions, OpenComputerVision, Stripe, and Swift.

positions.title: Class President
positions.description: Developed lesson plans and organized class structure in conjunction with the professor for a class of 50 students.
